opportunities.title: Develop coordinated arm-and-leg control
opportunities.summary: Compare motion planning and whole-body control on a biped with one added arm. TRON kits are research hardware; success on a laboratory policy does not establish a factory task.

reviewLinks.rationale: The TRON1-AP-YG datasheet explicitly supports separate arm/leg control and integrated whole-body-control research.
limitations: Use sole or wheeled mode; point-foot operation with this arm is not listed.
Researchers supply the task controller and measure stability, failures and recovery.

reviewLinks.rationale: LimX describes coordinated arm-leg control and grasping while moving for the mobile kit.
limitations: Manufacturer application claim, without a published evaluation dataset or success rate.
Use the single-arm 1.5 kg configuration; tabletop dual-arm specifications do not apply.

opportunities.title: Research picking objects from floor level
opportunities.summary: Develop a mobile robot policy that lowers the body and reaches forward to grasp a light object. The published TRON 2 kit workspace supports research; reliable pickup remains to be measured.

reviewLinks.rationale: The mobile-kit product page explicitly describes squatting and arm reach for floor-level pickup.
limitations: Research claim; no accepted-pick throughput, object set or failure denominator.
Qualify gripper opening, object mass, centre of mass and whole-body stability.

opportunities.title: Research reaching switches and control buttons
opportunities.summary: Evaluate mobile approach and arm positioning at switches or buttons within the kit workspace. This supports controlled interaction research, not unrestricted elevator or building access.
opportunities.setting: Instrumented laboratory wall and control-panel mock-up

reviewLinks.rationale: LimX names switches and elevator buttons as interaction points within the mobile-kit working-height range.
limitations: Confirm force control, button geometry and permission/interlocks in each test.
No certified elevator integration or unattended building-operation evidence was reviewed.

opportunities.title: Validate mapping and navigation on a legged platform
opportunities.summary: Build and evaluate maps, localization and obstacle-avoidance routes using the TRON 2 mobile kit sensors. Research teams measure map failures, route completion and operator interventions.

reviewLinks.rationale: The dedicated mobile-kit specification tab publishes its sensor suite, navigation functions and mapping measures.
limitations: Published 90% mapping success lacks a trial count and benchmark definition.
Navigation support is not evidence of defect detection, site inspection acceptance or continuous unattended operation.
